description: jobs-v1 orchestrated claims (additive, feature orchestration_v1; docs/contracts/jobs-v1.md "Orchestrated jobs"). `request` names the feature; `responses` are JobOrchestratedClaimResponse (and one JobRuntimeOrchestratedClaimResponse, for the kubevm check with `local_repository_name`) an entrypoint must accept; `refusals` are responses it must refuse (each fails the schema). `job` is a Job with its orchestration reference; `boundaries` are narrowJobDataBoundary cases with orchestration_titles; `branch_suffixes` are CreateJobRequest/CreateOrchestrationRequest `branch_suffix` values (jobs-v1 narrowing 2026-10-09: 8 hex digits alone or followed by `-`, any case, are reserved).
